test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, ‘CUTE’ is written as ‘FQWA’, and ‘BLUE’ is written as ‘EHXA’. How will ‘VOTE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**CUTE: FQWA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6206a2f02bd538ce8bc7f0beb302d01611b8d0fb7f720351e509aff085a446bb.png] 

**BLUE: EHXA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5054926dca4a6d052e6e21c29357279ae87025e82a809e8d66279c566b1f94f9.png] 

Similarly,

**VOTE: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd6c6928951539b57ac437415f9b98e5a4835c59fe5c84195e3523a8961252a4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"YKWA"**.
